# INC-42: orders 1.4.0 broke checkout

*Blameless postmortem. Opened 2026-10-04T09:00:03Z, resolved 2026-10-04T09:20:00Z by bob. Drafted by Relay (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) from the incident's record.*

## Summary

Release 1.4.0 of orders threw a NullPointerException for every order without a discount code, so about 40% of checkouts failed for twelve minutes. Relay traced the errors to the release and proposed reverting it; the revert was approved and opened as a draft pull request.

## Impact

Checkouts without a discount code failed from 08:58 to about 09:12 UTC: orders returned errors on 41% of requests and the gateway on 12%. The facts don't say how many customers retried.

## Detection

HighErrorRate fired on orders at 09:00:03, 1 min 43 s after the rollout, and on the gateway 30 s later.

## Root cause

DiscountService.apply in orders 1.4.0 calls trim() on the discount code without checking for null.

## Resolution

Relay proposed reverting the release in the deploy repo; alice approved, and Relay opened draft pull request #3 rolling orders back to 1.3.0. bob resolved the incident at 09:20.

## Timeline (UTC)

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 2026-10-04T08:58:20Z | orders 1.4.0 rolled out (#212). |
| 2026-10-04T09:00:03Z | HighErrorRate fired on orders. |
| 2026-10-04T09:01:05Z | Relay diagnosed a bad deploy of orders. |
| 2026-10-04T09:03:02Z | alice approved reverting the release. |
| 2026-10-04T09:03:10Z | Draft pull request #3 opened. |
| 2026-10-04T09:20:00Z | bob resolved the incident. |

## Action items

- [ ] **high** Add a test for orders without a discount code to the release pipeline. (orders team)
- [ ] **medium** Roll out orders releases to a canary first, gated on its error rate. (platform team)

## Lessons

- The symptom alert fired within two minutes, and the deploy history made the cause easy to confirm.
- Nothing between merge and rollout exercised an order without a discount code.
